query:
SELECT count(*) + 1 AS "entries!",
                  coalesce(sum(octet_length(key) + octet_length(value::text)), 0)::bigint
                      + octet_length($2::text) + octet_length($3::jsonb::text) AS "bytes!"
           FROM user_state
           WHERE user_id = $1 AND key <> $2::text
